Title: The Sands of Time
Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Plot: A delegation arrives, but won't negotiate with the queen. Phillipe steps up to act as king while Louis is at battle. Fabien mourns Claudine and seeks to avenge her murder. The king's mistress takes her jealousy too far.
